step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim to be worked on by IPOC.
Work item: Select 92 - Purge and Recreate or 93 - Manual Pay System to identify the main IPOC function being requested.
Work type: Select [the appropriate work type code based on the WI selected].

Remarks lines 1–4: Record the details of all the required claim information to establish the BP. Include any calculation information, information for additional transactions and claimant’s reports information. The officer must not indicate “See stored transactions.” Note
Remarks line 5: Type your name and telephone number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .

step.cmd: To transfer the registration number to IPOC, select the appropriate registration number from the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Go to Communicating decisions after calculation . Communicating decisions after calculation
